name: antigravity-booster
description: Orchestrates Google Antigravity for large parallel build-outs
author: Chris Williams <chris@voodootikigod.com> (https://github.com/voodootikigod)

scripts.build:agb: esbuild bin/agb.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/agb.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __agbCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __agbCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --define:__AGB_BUNDLED__=true --log-level=warning
scripts.build:mcp: esbuild mcp/server.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/mcp-server.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __agbCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __agbCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --define:__AGB_BUNDLED__=true --log-level=warning
scripts.build:hooks: esbuild hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/hooks/pre-tool-use.bundle.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __agbCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __agbCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --define:__AGB_BUNDLED__=true --log-level=warning
scripts.build: npm run build:agb && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:hooks && npm run vendor:bundle && node scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs
scripts.vendor:bundle: esbuild vendor/adlc/src/dispatch.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=vendor/adlc/dist/adlc.bundle.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __agbCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __agbCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning
